title: Anyone can burn any NFT in the `HoneyJarPortal`
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High, because the NFTs won't be retrievable from the portal anymore  **Likelihood:** High, because it does not require any preconditions to be exploited  ## Description  The `_debitFrom` method in `HoneyJarPortal` allows burning of any `HoneyJar` NFT, given its ID. This method is freely callable through `ONFT721Core`'s `sendFrom` method, which calls `_send` which calls the `_debitFrom` method without an access control check.
